_about: Phase 1 success criteria, pre-registered 2026-11-21 before any data download. Judged by mdqc.verify_phase1. Anything added after the download is labelled post hoc in docs/EDA_FINDINGS.md.

criteria.C1_event_counts: For each product code, the number of distinct mdr_report_key values downloaded equals the openFDA server total for the same search, queried immediately before that code's download (exact match).
criteria.C2_recall_counts: For each product code, downloaded recall records equal the server total for product_code:X (exact match).
criteria.C3_window: Every downloaded event has date_received inside 2022-01-01..2024-12-31 and its device list contains the searched product code.
criteria.C4_duplicates: Duplicate mdr_report_key values inside one code's file are counted and must be 0 after download paging; reports listed under two of our codes (multi-device reports) are counted and reported, not removed.
criteria.C5_checksums: Every raw file has a SHA-256 in data/checksums.sha256 (committed); the verifier recomputes them.
criteria.C6_independent_recount: Every number published in docs/EDA_FINDINGS.md comes from results/phase1/eda_summary.json, and the verifier recomputes all of them from the raw files with separate code (standard library only, no pandas): 100% match.
criteria.C7_privacy: No raw data, database or .env in git (test + verifier); the count of records carrying manufacturer contact name/phone fields is reported so Phase 2 can drop them.

eda_questions._note: Descriptive questions fixed in advance so the findings doc answers them all, including the boring or inconvenient answers.
eda_questions.Q1: Monthly report volume per product code; any months more than 3x the code's median month.
eda_questions.Q2: Event type mix (Death / Injury / Malfunction / Other / blank) per code.
eda_questions.Q3: Top 10 FDA product problem terms per code.
eda_questions.Q4: Top manufacturers per code and the share of the largest one (concentration).
eda_questions.Q5: Share of reports with narrative text; narrative length (median, 90th percentile) per code.
eda_questions.Q6: Recalls per code by year initiated and by root cause; how many recalls fall inside the report window.
eda_questions.Q7: Reporting lag: date_received minus date_of_event (median, 90th percentile) where both exist.
eda_questions.Q8: Reports that list more than one device or more than one of our product codes.

phase_done_when: C1-C7 pass, the EDA notebook runs top to bottom, docs/EDA_FINDINGS.md is generated (not hand-typed) and ends with the 'Why we did these tasks' table, the verifier runs in CI on a committed sample fixture, and the full-data verifier evidence is committed.
